I am an old woman of 71 years here in Balaka, and my small piece of land is all I have to feed my family. The rains have been poor these past seasons, so I must use what little I can to make the maize grow. I will buy a small bag of fertilizer if the subsidy coupon reaches me, and I put the goat manure I collect on the field too. My grandchildren help me weed and plant because my back is tired, and sometimes I ask a neighbor's boy to help with the heavy digging for a little money or some maize.
